style: User-approved Theater 1 illustration: restrained drawn contours, simplified painted surfaces, natural proportions; neither photorealistic nor exaggerated anime. Each task retains its own time, light, and wrong thing.

tasks.name: Situation Anomaly Theater 1
tasks.detail: Old downtown single-screen movie theater building. TIME/LIGHT: late afternoon, dusty warm sepia sunlight, faded colors. WRONG THING: every blank poster frame shows the same empty seat.

tasks.name: Situation Anomaly Theater 2
tasks.detail: Empty cinema auditorium seen from the back row. TIME/LIGHT: dark, only the projector beam, red velvet seats. WRONG THING: the screen shows this same auditorium from the front, and one seat in that image is folded down.

tasks.name: Situation Anomaly Mall 1
tasks.detail: Department store atrium with escalators. TIME/LIGHT: bright midday, clean white and cream, sunlight through a glass roof. WRONG THING: completely empty, all escalators running, a shopping cart stopped halfway up the escalator.

tasks.name: Situation Anomaly Mall 2
tasks.detail: Underground shopping arcade corridor with shutters. TIME/LIGHT: sickly green-tinted fluorescent light, a few tubes flickering. WRONG THING: the corridor continues far longer than possible, the same shop repeating.

tasks.name: Situation Anomaly Restaurant 1
tasks.detail: Narrow food alley with tent bars and plastic stools. TIME/LIGHT: dusk, warm orange sodium streetlamps and steam. WRONG THING: every table is set with steaming food and full glasses, but no one is there.

tasks.name: Situation Anomaly Restaurant 2
tasks.detail: Small Korean restaurant interior, low tables. TIME/LIGHT: morning, flat pale daylight, beige and wood tones. WRONG THING: all the chairs face the wall.

tasks.name: Situation Anomaly Church 1
tasks.detail: Small hillside church. TIME/LIGHT: overcast winter noon, light snow, nearly black-and-white. WRONG THING: the cross on the roof is upside down and only the church has no snow on it.

tasks.name: Situation Anomaly Church 2
tasks.detail: Inside an empty church, pews, tall windows. TIME/LIGHT: early morning, cold blue light through stained glass in pale colors. WRONG THING: the pews have all been turned to face the entrance.

tasks.name: Situation Anomaly Bathhouse 1
tasks.detail: Old neighborhood bathhouse with a tall brick chimney. TIME/LIGHT: dawn, pink-lavender sky, steam rising. WRONG THING: the steam from the chimney flows downward to the ground.

tasks.name: Situation Anomaly Bathhouse 2
tasks.detail: Inside a public bath, tiled pools, low stools and basins. TIME/LIGHT: warm yellow light, thick steam, aqua tiles. WRONG THING: the pool water is perfectly still and black like ink while everything else is wet and steamy.

tasks.name: Situation Anomaly Store 1
tasks.detail: 24-hour convenience store on a corner. TIME/LIGHT: 4 a.m., cold white light spilling from the store onto a dry dark street. WRONG THING: the store is lit and open, but every other building on the street has vanished into flat darkness.

tasks.name: Situation Anomaly Store 2
tasks.detail: Inside a convenience store, aisles and fridges. TIME/LIGHT: harsh white fluorescent, slightly overexposed. WRONG THING: every product on the shelves is the same identical item.

tasks.name: Situation Anomaly Arcade 1
tasks.detail: Basement entrance of a karaoke and PC room building, stairs going down. TIME/LIGHT: dusk, purple and cyan neon (signs blank). WRONG THING: the stairs go down much farther than one floor, out of sight.

tasks.name: Situation Anomaly Arcade 2
tasks.detail: Small karaoke room with sofa and microphones. TIME/LIGHT: dark room, only the screen glow in deep red. WRONG THING: both microphones are hanging in the air by their cords from the ceiling, swaying.

tasks.name: Situation Anomaly Library 1
tasks.detail: Old public library or museum building with a lawn. TIME/LIGHT: bright sunny afternoon, green trees, clear blue sky. WRONG THING: all windows are dark, and the building's shadow points toward the sun.

tasks.name: Situation Anomaly Library 2
tasks.detail: Library stacks between tall bookshelves. TIME/LIGHT: dim warm amber lamps, dust in the air. WRONG THING: one book floats in midair, open, between the shelves.

tasks.name: Situation Anomaly Parking 1
tasks.detail: Underground parking garage, concrete pillars. TIME/LIGHT: dim yellow-green sodium lights, dry concrete. WRONG THING: one car with all doors open in the middle of the lane, headlights on.

tasks.name: Situation Anomaly Parking 2
tasks.detail: Top deck of a multi-level parking tower. TIME/LIGHT: hazy daytime, washed-out grey-white sky. WRONG THING: fresh footprints walk to the edge of the deck and stop.

tasks.name: Situation Anomaly Rooftop 1
tasks.detail: Apartment rooftop with water tanks and laundry lines. TIME/LIGHT: golden sunset, long shadows, warm orange. WRONG THING: the laundry on the lines blows in the opposite direction from the trees below.

tasks.name: Situation Anomaly Rooftop 2
tasks.detail: Office rooftop door slightly open, stairwell behind. TIME/LIGHT: dense morning fog, white and grey, very soft. WRONG THING: the open doorway shows a sunny blue sky instead of a stairwell.

tasks.name: Situation Anomaly Bridge 1
tasks.detail: Long river bridge. TIME/LIGHT: dawn, thick pale fog, faint pink. WRONG THING: the bridge disappears into the fog and the far end is not there at all.

tasks.name: Situation Anomaly Bridge 2
tasks.detail: Pedestrian overpass above an empty road. TIME/LIGHT: noon, harsh sun, crisp hard shadows, dry. WRONG THING: the road below is completely empty in every direction at midday, and a single shoe sits in the middle of the overpass.

tasks.name: Situation Anomaly Police 1
tasks.detail: Small neighborhood police box. TIME/LIGHT: rainy evening, the box lit warm yellow, wet street. WRONG THING: a phone receiver hangs off the hook outside, and the inside is perfectly tidy and empty.

tasks.name: Situation Anomaly Police 2
tasks.detail: Detention corridor with cell bars. TIME/LIGHT: cold flat fluorescent, pale green-grey, almost colorless. WRONG THING: every cell door is open except one, which is locked from the inside.

tasks.name: Situation Anomaly Military 1
tasks.detail: Military base gate and guard post in the hills. TIME/LIGHT: overcast autumn day, khaki and dull olive. WRONG THING: the gate is wide open and the fallen leaves stop in a straight line at the gate.

tasks.name: Situation Anomaly Military 2
tasks.detail: Inside an old concrete bunker, metal door, pipes. TIME/LIGHT: one red emergency lamp, deep shadows. WRONG THING: the heavy metal door is bulging outward from the inside.

tasks.name: Situation Anomaly Restroom 1
tasks.detail: Public restroom building in a park. TIME/LIGHT: summer afternoon, bright green trees, cicada-hot light. WRONG THING: the open doorway is pitch black inside despite the bright sun.

tasks.name: Situation Anomaly Restroom 2
tasks.detail: Old school restroom, row of stalls, mirror. TIME/LIGHT: one flickering white tube light, pale tiles. WRONG THING: the mirror shows all stall doors closed while in the room they are all open.

tasks.name: Situation Anomaly Bus 1
tasks.detail: Rural bus stop shelter by rice fields. TIME/LIGHT: hot summer noon, heat haze, saturated blue sky and green fields. WRONG THING: the shelter casts no shadow, and a bus waits on the road with its doors open and no driver.

tasks.name: Situation Anomaly Bus 2
tasks.detail: Inside a city bus. TIME/LIGHT: night, the bus lit cold blue-white, black windows. WRONG THING: through the windows there is nothing outside, only black, and all the stop-request buttons are lit.

tasks.name: Situation Anomaly Lake 1
tasks.detail: Reservoir with a wooden fishing deck. TIME/LIGHT: early morning mist, silver and pale teal, mirror-still water. WRONG THING: the reflection in the water shows a pair of shoes on the deck, but the real deck is empty.

tasks.name: Situation Anomaly Lake 2
tasks.detail: Old stone well in a village courtyard. TIME/LIGHT: dry autumn afternoon, persimmon tree, warm brown and orange. WRONG THING: a rope goes down into the well and is pulled tight, as if something is holding it.
